name: pos-sales-etl-demo
description: Import messy Thai POS/ERP report exports into PostgreSQL and reconcile sales vs purchases to the satang.

scripts.import:samples: node src/cli.js import sales samples/sales_DEMO_2026-08_part1.csv samples/sales_DEMO_2026-08_part2.csv --company DEMO --no-refresh && node src/cli.js import sales samples/sales_DEMO2_2026-08.csv --company DEMO2 --no-refresh && node src/cli.js import purchase samples/purchase_DEMO_2026-08.csv --company DEMO --no-refresh && node src/cli.js import purchase samples/purchase_DEMO2_2026-08.csv --company DEMO2
